column2: 🔌️mcp carries the MCP entry of the cli: the stdio runner, result conversion, argument and path guards.
🎼️mcp_prompt carries the MCP prompt template rendering and prompt handlers of the cli.
🛎️mcp_tool_repo carries the MCP tool handlers of the cli for analysis, policy, tickets, drafts, todos, goals, export and contributors.
🧬️mcp_tool_codebase carries the MCP tool handlers of the cli for folders, files, sections, artifact moves, graphql and navigation.
🏬️mcp_resource carries the MCP resource handlers of the cli.
🗣️mcp_description carries the MCP tool and prompt descriptions of the cli.
🏭️mcp_factory carries the MCP server factory of the cli with the ticket handlers and hook and MCP runners.
🧩️mcp_protocol carries the MCP protocol types and builders of the cli.
🖥️mcp_adapter carries the MCP server adapter of the cli: server registry, listings and the stdio JSON-RPC loop.
